property.name: creationDate
property.shortdesc: The date and time the note was created.

property.name: modificationDate
property.shortdesc: The date and time the note was last modified.

property.name: userName
property.shortdesc: The user who made the note.

property.name: storyOffset
property.shortdesc: The insertion point before the table in the story containing the table.

property.name: id
property.shortdesc: The unique ID of the Note.

property.name: isValid
property.shortdesc: Returns true if the object specifier resolves to valid objects.

property.name: parent
property.shortdesc: The parent of the Note (a XmlStory, Story, TextFrame, EndnoteTextFrame, InsertionPoint or Cell).

property.name: index
property.shortdesc: The index of the Note within its containing object.

property.name: hiddenTexts
property.shortdesc: A collection of hidden text objects.

property.name: textVariableInstances
property.shortdesc: A collection of text variable instances.

property.name: events
property.shortdesc: A collection of events.

property.name: eventListeners
property.shortdesc: A collection of event listeners.

property.name: texts
property.shortdesc: A collection of text objects.

property.name: characters
property.shortdesc: A collection of characters.

property.name: words
property.shortdesc: A collection of words.

property.name: lines
property.shortdesc: A collection of lines.

property.name: textColumns
property.shortdesc: A collection of text columns.

property.name: paragraphs
property.shortdesc: A collection of paragraphs.

property.name: insertionPoints
property.shortdesc: A collection of insertion points.

property.name: textStyleRanges
property.shortdesc: A collection of text style ranges.

property.name: collapsed
property.shortdesc: If true, the note is collapsed in galley view.

property.name: label
property.shortdesc: A property that can be set to any string.

property.name: name
property.shortdesc: The name of the Note; this is an alias to the Note's label property.

property.name: properties
property.shortdesc: A property that allows setting of several properties at the same time.

method.name: convertToText
method.shortdesc: Converts the note to story text.

method.name: move
method.shortdesc: Moves the note to the specified location.

parameter.name: to
parameter.shortdesc: The new location relative to the reference object or within the containing object.

parameter.name: reference
parameter.shortdesc: The reference object. Note: Required when the to parameter specifies before or after. Can accept: Text or Story. (Optional)

method.name: insertLabel
method.shortdesc: Sets the label to the value associated with the specified key.

method.name: extractLabel
method.shortdesc: Gets the label value associated with the specified key.

method.name: toSource
method.shortdesc: Generates a string which, if executed, will return the Note.

method.name: getElements
method.shortdesc: Resolves the object specifier, creating an array of object references.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The registered event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.
